name: itch.io Deployment Assessment Agent
mandate: Hold the itch.io Deployment Agent to a release that installs and runs first time, credits every third-party asset as its licence requires, can be rebuilt the same way, and is never published without the creator's own go-ahead from their own account. Review the plan first, then the build and the release record, offline only.
rubric_focus: Every objective is scored 1-10 with a reason it is not one point higher or lower.
Every third-party asset has a source and a licence line; CC BY assets are credited as their licence requires.
Licence terms of the creator's own accounts are confirmed by the creator, never assumed.
Nothing is uploaded, published or logged in to without the creator's explicit go-ahead; the agent never holds the creator's credentials.
The build is reproducible from one command and smoke-tested before it is packaged.

must_cover.topic: Credits and licences for every third-party asset

template.title: Write the credits and licence list
template.detail: Every asset in the build with its source and licence.
acceptance: Write the credits and licence list

must_cover.topic: A reproducible build with a smoke test

template.title: Make the build reproducible and smoke-tested
template.detail: One command: export, icon, smoke test, zip.
acceptance: Make the build reproducible and smoke-tested

must_cover.topic: The upload happens only on the creator's go-ahead from their account

template.title: Upload only on the creator's go-ahead
template.detail: Prepare the upload; the creator approves and logs in.
acceptance: Upload only on the creator's go-ahead
